which, you know, remember when Donald Trumpissued his executive order on day one about birthright citizenship?The working assumption was thatit was not just unconstitutional, but it was damn near what we saw was a decision that came outthe right way, but, you know, was quite narrow.I mean, it's reported as six three, and that's technically true.But if you look at just the constitutional on the horizon.This is a court that is not a friend of democracy.When you look at what's and VNC this case that that did go your wayhaving to do with whether ballotshave to come in by election Day or be postmarked by Election Day.We talked about this one with me as a layperson, as a non-lawyer,and it seems to me that the only consistent standard, because we don'tnecessarily know how long a ballot When that failed, we had January 6th.So, you know, the the rhetoric is all around. Right.Donald Trump has been clear now for months that he is going to try to underminefree and fair elections this, this November.Then we saw the legislative actions.And as you point out, it is his the Department of Justice has broughtagainst 31 jurisdictions, 30 states plus D.C.,to try to access the most sensitive voter informationthat states maintain on their citizenstheir name, their address, far.Donald Trump is over 11 at the trial courts.He is over one at the Court of Appeals.So he lost 11 cases in states.He appealed.They appealed Michigan to the Sixth Circuit,a pretty conservative circuit, and they lost there.But these cases continue.You know,I've said that these are not the last losses that Donald Trump is going to have.I suspect he will go at least over 15 before anything you know happens.He could go over 31 for all I know.But but these are now going to turn to other courts of appealswhere there are appeals pending.And I feel pretty good about how those are going.Final thing I want to ask about at the end of all of this, there's the fear,I guess we would call it, of Donald Trump declaringsome kind of national emergency.That's a phrase that's often used.What does constitutional authoritiesat the time, place and manner of elections and to conduct those elections.So so the president has no role.Congress, through appropriatelegislation can override this this
